description: This file defines the ConvertUOM class, which provides units of measurement (UOM) conversion functionalities, including unit definitions, conversion factors, and the core CONVERT method for unit conversions, including temperature conversions.

classes.name: ConvertUOM
classes.description: Class providing units of measurement conversions, unit definitions, and temperature conversion logic.

methods.name: getConversionCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of the different conversion categories for units of measure.

methods.name: getConversionCategoryUnits
methods.description: Returns an array of units for a specified conversion category or all if null.

methods.name: getConversionCategoryUnitDetails
methods.description: Returns detailed information about units within a specific conversion category.

methods.name: getConversionMultipliers
methods.description: Returns standard metric multiplier prefixes used with units.

methods.name: getBinaryConversionMultipliers
methods.description: Returns binary multiplier prefixes used with information units.

methods.name: CONVERT
methods.description: Main method to convert a value between specified units of measurement, including temperature conversions.

methods.name: getUOMDetails
methods.description: Helper method to parse and retrieve details for a given unit of measure, including category and multiplier.

methods.name: convertTemperature
methods.description: Converts temperature values between different temperature units, handling synonyms and different scales.

methods.name: resolveTemperatureSynonyms
methods.description: Maps temperature unit synonyms to standard units.
